parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Describes the video AND its generation parameters: include duration (3-10s) and aspect ratio (16:9 or 9:16) in the text, e.g. '5 second, 9:16 video.' If an image is provided, say how to use it ('Use the image as the first frame.'). Required unless a native 'input' array is provided.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Optional image (max 1): http(s) URL or gs:// URI (no base64 — upload local files and pass the URL). Whether it is used as first frame or reference is controlled by the prompt text. PNG/JPEG/WebP/HEIC/HEIF.

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: true (default): async — submit returns immediately, poll the status endpoint. false: sync — the submit HTTP call blocks ~1-3 minutes and returns with the request already terminal.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Advanced/testing: a native Interactions API 'input' array forwarded verbatim to the upstream (prompt/image are ignored when set). uri fields must be gs://; inline base64 goes in 'data'. Upstream rejections come back raw in outcome.error.
